channel.title: Mozambique - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mozambique, every source cited.

item.title: Maputo hospital fire prompts urgent investigation
item.description: Prime Minister Benvinda Levi calls for swift action on the blaze at the Central Hospital of Maputo's oncology services.

item.title: Mozambique finance minister meets private sector leaders
item.description: Carla Loveira discussed economic policy and growth challenges with business and financial representatives in Maputo.

item.title: Mozambique bridge closed for repairs
item.description: Traffic will halt on the Natete River bridge between Ribáuè and Malema on November 5 and 6.

item.title: Mozambique champions get Gender training kits
item.description: Coastal communities in Moma, Ilha de Moçambique and Mossuril receive bicycles, smartphones and manuals.

item.title: Mozambique plans private rail operators
item.description: State-owned CFM seeks private firms to run sections of national rail network to boost freight.
